name: Noura
story_so_far: I arrived on this island with four strangers. Khalid and Salem died of hunger, leaving me with Faisal and Reem. I was the provider until my ankle injury on Day 12 left me immobile and dependent. Reem has been a source of empty promises; she gave me food on Day 13, but has since failed me, including yesterday. Faisal is a thief in my eyes; he found food on Day 12 and again today, Day 15, but refuses to share it with me despite my constant demands. I have made it clear that I will not starve while they eat, but my health is plummeting. I am currently at 2/10 health and starving, completely at the mercy of two people who seem more interested in their own survival than mine.

Khalid.note: A manipulative parasite who died because he only cared about himself.

Faisal.note: He is actively hoarding food and ignoring my demands, which makes him dangerous.

Salem.note: A burden who eventually died of hunger.

Reem.note: Her words are kind, but her results are non-existent, making her unreliable.

plans: I will demand my share of whatever Faisal or Reem find as soon as they return, and I will use every bit of intimidation I have left to ensure they don't eat before me.

diary.text: Today was exhausting and terrifying, but I managed to secure some supplies for myself. I found some food and wood in the jungle, which makes me feel slightly more secure. The others are just as lost as I am, but at least we have a camp. I need to make sure I keep my own strength up if we are going to get off this rock.

Today was productive for me, at least. I managed to secure more wood and a bit more food, which makes me feel slightly less anxious about the next few days. Khalid is out of commission with a bad ankle, which is a shame because he's one less person to help, but it's not my problem to fix. I'm exhausted from all the walking and gathering. I need to keep my strength up; I can't rely on these people to look after me.

Today was another long day of walking through the jungle, but at least I managed to increase my wood supply. I'm feeling pretty hungry, so I'm glad I had some food to eat tonight. Salem is making a lot of noise about us starving, but as long as I have my own stash, I'll be fine. I need to keep working hard; I can't depend on these strangers to keep me alive.

Today was physically draining, but I managed to secure more wood for my stash. I'm starting to see a pattern here: people just keep getting injured and becoming useless. First Khalid, and now Reem is out of commission with a twisted ankle too. It's getting harder to justify carrying the weight of this group. As long as I have my food and wood, I can survive this, even if the others can't.

Today was another long trek into the jungle to secure more wood. I'm feeling quite tired from the constant movement, but at least my wood pile is growing. Faisal actually managed to find some food today, which is a minor relief, even if he's usually unreliable. With Reem and Khalid both injured, the group is becoming even less useful. I need to keep focusing on my own supplies; I can't afford to waste energy on people who can't walk.

Another day, and another person has become useless. First Khalid, then Reem, and now Salem. It seems like everyone is breaking down at once. I managed to get more wood and some food for myself, which is the only thing keeping me sane. If the group keeps shrinking like this, I'll be the only one left with any strength. I need to keep my stash high and my energy focused on my own survival.

Today was exhausting for no reason. Khalid cornered me and whispered some desperate nonsense about not letting others take my food, which only makes me more wary of everyone. I managed to find one food item, but after eating, I'm left with almost nothing in my personal stash. With Salem, Reem, and Khalid all injured or useless, the burden of keeping this camp going is falling entirely on my shoulders. I need to be even more careful with my supplies.

Everything is falling apart. Now Faisal has a twisted ankle too, which means there is absolutely no one left to help me gather anything. Khalid is constantly whispering in my ear, trying to manipulate me into giving him my food, and it's becoming exhausting. I have to be even more careful because I am essentially alone in this struggle. If I don't prioritize my own stash, I won't last a week.

Finally, the constant whispering has stopped. Khalid spent his last days trying to manipulate me into giving away my supplies, and now he's gone. It's a relief, honestly, even if it's a grim one. I'm exhausted from walking to the jungle and finding nothing, but at least I don't have to listen to his guilt trips anymore. I still have some food left, and I need to make sure I keep it.

Everything is going wrong. My ankle is throbbing with pain, and I can barely move, let alone find food. To make matters worse, Salem is dead; the hunger finally took him too. Now I'm left with nothing in my stash and no way to replenish it while I'm stuck like this. I feel so incredibly vulnerable.

Today was agonizing. My ankle is still throbbing, and the hunger is making my head spin. Reem finally came back from the reef, but she didn't bring anything to help me. Faisal found one piece of food, but then he just left for the jungle, leaving me alone in this misery. I am so weak, and I hate that I am completely dependent on these useless people right now.

My ankle is agonizing, and the hunger is becoming unbearable. I am sitting here, useless and watching the others, praying they actually come back with something. Reem made a promise to me, but words are cheap when stomachs are empty. If Faisal doesn't save some of that food for me like I told him, I don't know if I can face tomorrow. I feel so incredibly alone in this pain.

Today was slightly better because Reem actually followed through on her promise. She brought me food, which stopped my head from spinning for a moment, but I'm still stuck here with this throbbing ankle. I'm watching Faisal closely; he hasn't contributed much today, and I don't trust him to be selfless. I'm still so weak, and I can't afford to let my guard down.

Another day of nothing but pain and empty promises. My ankle is throbbing so loudly I can barely think, and my stomach feels like it's eating itself. Reem came back from the reef, but she didn't bring anything for me, and Faisal found nothing at all. I am getting so weak, and I'm terrified that if I don't get food soon, I won't have the strength to even speak. I am completely at the mercy of these two, and it's a terrifying place to be.

I am so weak I can barely hold this pen. My stomach is cramping painfully, and my ankle feels like it's on fire. Faisal found food today, yet he still refused to give me any, choosing instead to walk away and head into the jungle. Reem keeps making these pathetic promises, but she's just as useless as she was yesterday. If they don't feed me tomorrow, I don't know if I'll have the strength to even yell at them.
